svg.title: Bitcoin learning time
svg.desc: Daily learning time from 19 Oct 2025 to 21 Oct 2026. Tracking began 20 Oct 2026. Total recorded: 6 h 5 min. Outlined squares have no entry. Filled grey means a reported zero. Green levels are under 1 hour, 1 to under 2 hours, 2 to under 4 hours, and 4 hours or more.
